In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the Role We're looking for our first hospitality fan Sales person in NRW. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market. In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more. What You’ll Do Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate: Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about Create engaging ways to show our product Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path What You’ll Need You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry: Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech A minimum of 3 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality You are comfortable working in both English and German If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers. Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary & Uncapped Commission Flexible time off Team events What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. Own a specific geographical region or country within the EMEA market which includes target-accounts and an existing book of business that has companies with 3000+ employees. Primary focus is on hunting new business opportunities, building sales pipeline, and driving growth within the ENT sector. Upscaling existing account base through expansion and upsell, leveraging our Extended Access Management Identity. How we’re using AI today Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here. Expectations of this role This is a remote opportunity within the UK. You will also regularly engage in customer-facing activities, including in-person meetings, events, and other travel required to effectively support your territory. Travel within your assigned territory, and occasionally outside of it, will be a part of your job, and you are responsible for managing your schedule in a way that works for the company and you. Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. What we're looking for: 5+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably in security with a focus on Enterprise accounts OR top performance in MidMarket/Commercial and ready to step up. Proven Enterprise AE success; Southern Europe enterprise selling experience; cybersecurity or identity background; evidence of personally creating and closing complex enterprise opportunities. Experience building an immature/whitespace territory; CISO and senior security buyer relationships; strong new-logo hunting record; experience balancing strategic deals with volume; MEDDPICC or comparable enterprise sales methodology. (EMEA) Demonstrated success in owning and growing a geographical territory or country within EMEA. Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and KPIs. Outstanding sales skills in prospecting, pipeline building, strategic account planning, value-based selling, and territory management, with meticulous operating rigor in pipeline management, forecasting, and pacing to target Demonstrated success in upselling & cross-selling to both new customers and across a book of business, and in uncovering customer pain points beyond what's initially shared Proficient skills in business acumen, negotiation, relationship building, communication & presentation skills to C-Suite Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate complex cybersecurity concepts, particularly in Identity and Access Management. Self-motivated, driven, and able to work independently in a remote setting. Preferable proficiency with Salesforce, Slack, Zoom, Linkedin Sales Navigator & Outreach Nice to have: Existing channel relationships; Middle East and Africa experience; Italian and/or Spanish language capability. Please note that this job description is subject to modifications and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities. What you can expect: Own Your Territory: Manage and grow your designated geographical region or country within EMEA, focusing on acquiring new ENT clients and expanding existing accounts. Manage Pipeline: Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through proactive prospecting (cold calling, and networking), supplemented with inbound leads and effective pipeline development inline with our sales methodology. Drive New Business Growth: Key Activities for effective sales strategies to meet and exceed sales targets including: Strategic Territory Segmentation: Refine client targeting by segmenting against Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) that align with enterprise needs and priorities. Contextual Business Understanding & Multithreading: Develop deep insights into the enterprise's structure, key decision-makers, and buying processes. Implement multithreading to engage various stakeholders across departments, ensuring broad influence and deeper engagement. Excellence in Outbound & Pipeline Generation: Leverage a combination of self-generated outreach, BDR collaboration, and marketing-driven initiatives to consistently build a high-quality pipeline. Tailored Discovery & Scoping: Align 1Password’s value to the enterprise's unique challenges through comprehensive discovery and scoping, ensuring that proposed solutions are relevant and impactful at scale. Continuous Improvement via Coaching: Maintain a growth mindset by actively participating in high-quality coaching sessions, driving incremental improvements in sales performance weekly Drive Organic Growth: Identify opportunities to expand and cross-sell 1Password’s solutions within existing accounts by building key stakeholder relationships and leveraging your understanding of Extended Access Management. Engage the Industry: Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to represent 1Password, build brand presence and build relationships with potential customers Stay Informed: Stay up to date on cybersecurity trends and developments, particularly in Identity and Access Management, to provide valuable insights to clients and position 1Password as an industry leader. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Internal Collaboration: Foster strong partnerships with internal teams such as BDR, Solutions, Channels, Onboarding, and Customer Success to craft tailored solutions that address the complex needs of enterprise clients, ensuring alignment across the customer journey. Multithreaded Client Engagement: Develop and maintain relationships across multiple stakeholders within enterprise client organizations, including C-level, IT, and security teams. This approach ensures a comprehensive understanding of the client's business, enhancing account health and expanding long-term value. Focus on Solution-Driven Selling: Implement 1Password methodology to ensure our solutions are strategically aligned with client goals and tailored to their specific needs. Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of client challenges, and position our offerings as impactful, customized solutions that drive value and outcomes. Present and Negotiate: Confidently present to executives, articulating the value proposition of our products and services. Create mutual action plans to align the sales team and prospects on responsibilities, steps and timelines for closing deals. Utilize effective negotiation skills to drive mutually beneficial outcomes. UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £87,000 GBP and £126,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. How we work with AI We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password. This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. Our approach to work We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement. For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. Soon they'll need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - site sourcing, feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, dataroom analysis, and more. The Role You will work on one of the core systems behind what Davis delivers. Our agents take raw, fragmented data and turn it into deliverables that real estate professionals use to make high-stakes decisions. Your job is to make that pipeline reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from work done by the best human teams - then push it beyond what any human team could do. You can expect to: Build and operate multi-agent systems that turn heterogeneous data into expert-grade deliverables across real estate development workflows. Own the system end to end: infra, orchestration, context engineering, how the system selects, structures, and injects the right information so agents behave reliably at scale. Ensure production-grade quality, performance, and reliability across every output we deliver to clients. Sit with clients and domain experts regularly to understand their constraints, challenge your own assumptions, and make sure every output meets and even exceeds clients' expectations. Beyond the technical depth, this role will expose you to how real estate decisions are made, how clients think, and what it takes to deliver outputs they trust. You'll develop a sharp business intuition alongside your engineering skills. Key Responsibilities Harness engineering: design and build the system layer around the model - context assembly, tool orchestration, verification, and report generation - to deliver consistent, high-quality outputs at scale. Data ingestion & context assembly: handle messy, unstructured project data from heterogeneous sources and ensure agents have the right context at all times. Storage & traceability: persist sources, extracted facts, intermediate results, report versions, and expert edits. Expert-in-the-loop UX: design and build the review experience (annotations, edits, approvals, diffs/version history, provenance display). Evaluation & benchmarking: build an internal eval harness (datasets, rubrics, regression tests, monitoring) to track agents performance over time. What We're Looking For 1.5+ years building and deploying production software at scale (APIs, reliability, testing, performance). Experience building and evaluating LLM agents / multi-step workflows in real systems. Proven context engineering experience: you've built systems where reliability depends on assembling the right context (RAG over heterogeneous sources, summarization, conversation state, tool outputs). Deep Python expertise (clean architecture, typing, async/concurrency, strong testing culture). Strong experience with databases + data modeling (structured storage, document storage, versioning). Full-stack experience (you can ship a real UI), with a clear backend emphasis. Comfortable building from first principles: we don't want heavy agent frameworks — we prefer a lightweight, well-engineered codebase. Nice to Have Experience operating LLM systems with observability and quality monitoring in production. GIS familiarity (parcels, zoning layers, geocoding). Multi-country product experience (heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules). NLP background Why Join Us You're joining a team of 9 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours. Direct impact on growth: your work doesn't sit behind three layers of review. You ship, clients use it, and you see the results. Every output you improve translates directly into revenue and reputation. Real-world impact: your work supports investment decisions, accelerates development timelines, and helps redefine how cities are imagined, designed, and built. High ownership: own the full feasibility stack end to end, as the CEO of that part. Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company. A small team with high standards - we ship fast and love working together. More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after: Team Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need. Why We'll Win Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. description:
The Robotics & Mechatronics Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a C++ Software Engineer (m/f/d) Platform Infrastructure, who will help build and maintain the C++ platform infrastructure our robot runs on. You will help us ensure it runs reliably and safely once it is out of the lab and in production.

Responsibilities

  • Platform Development: Develop and maintain modern C++ software components for the robot's Linux-based platform infrastructure.
  • Communication & IPC: Build and maintain the IPC and communication interfaces that connect robot applications, backend services, and hardware-facing components.
  • Debugging & Diagnostics: Debug concurrency, timing, memory, performance, and system-integration issues across the platform.
  • Testing Infrastructure: Build unit, integration, and hardware-oriented test infrastructure for platform components.
  • Reliability & Observability: Improve system reliability through better diagnostics, logging, fault handling, and recovery mechanisms.
  • Hardware Integration: Test and integrate software on real robotic hardware, working with firmware, control, backend, QA, and DevOps engineers when problems cross those boundaries.

Essential Skills

  • Background: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience, with initial professional experience building production C++ software, typically up to about three years and excluding internships or working-student positions.
  • Modern C++: Hands-on experience writing C++ using modern practices (C++17/C++20), gained through professional work, internships, or substantial project experience.
  • Systems Programming: Working understanding of Linux system programming — processes, threads, synchronization, IPC, and sockets — along with asynchronous programming concepts.
  • Debugging: Practical debugging experience using tools such as GDB, sanitizers (ASan/TSan/UBSan), or Valgrind, applied to problems that span multiple interacting software or hardware components.
  • Testing: Experience writing automated tests with frameworks such as GoogleTest, including meaningful unit and integration test coverage.

Beneficial Skills

  • Robotics & Industrial Background: Experience with robotics, industrial automation, or embedded systems, including industrial communication protocols such as EtherCAT, CAN, or similar.
  • Hardware-in-the-Loop Testing: Experience with hardware-in-the-loop, simulation, fault-injection, or other automated system-testing approaches.
  • Embedded Linux: Experience with real-time or performance-sensitive Linux systems, or with the deployment side of embedded Linux.
  • Python Tooling: Experience using Python for testing, automation, or developer tooling.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Experience using AI-assisted development tools, combined with critically reviewing and validating the generated output.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

description: Change and Transformation Manager – Client Delivery (French/english) Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office; occasional travel to Brussels and London) Level: Programme Manager senior Team: Client Delivery Contract: Permanent Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead Please note: This role is based in France, so you need to live here or be open to relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities. Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English. About Kaluza Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life. With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen. What you’ll do Own change and transformation support for go-live readiness for ENGIE France’s migration onto Kaluza as the hands-on lead, from planning through cutover, hypercare and transition towards scaling, so ENGIE’s teams are ready and confident to adopt the platform from day one. Decide the change approach for the programme: stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, training design and business readiness engagement, shaped to ENGIE France’s operating context and owned by their teams. Operate Kaluza’s business readiness governance: stage gates, readiness evidence, risk and dependency tracking and weekly reporting. Partner with the Learning and Adoption Specialist in France to coordinate training, Train the Trainer and knowledge content, so enablement lands throughout each programme increment as we build out and release features via Agile delivery. Be the day-to-day point of contact for ENGIE France on business readiness, change and adoption, giving practical change advice to their transformation leads. Track adoption and operational stability through hypercare, root-cause any shortfall against acceptance criteria, and agree interventions with ENGIE. Improve Kaluza’s readiness playbook: evolve what worked on ENGIE Belgium, test fixes where it falls short in France, and share what you learn with colleagues across Client Delivery to shape the platform’s operational foundations and improvements and to set our global standards. Day to day, the activities you’ll lead or support include: Change impact and readiness planning: diagnosing the full scope of impacts across roles, workflows, systems and customer experience, then turning them into a prioritised readiness plan sequenced against delivery, migration and release cadence. Stakeholders, sponsors and change networks: mapping stakeholders and influence at workstream level, helping sponsors stay visible and engaged, and shaping the champion, superuser and people-manager networks that carry change into ENGIE’s business. Communications and resistance: supporting ENGIE France’s own communications and engagement strategy, so their teams and customers hear a consistent, positive story about the programme. You’ll help leaders and champions advocate for the change, internally and with customers, and anticipate where resistance may form so you can intervene before it becomes entrenched. Migration and go-live readiness: building the business and operational readiness evidence that enables a smooth transfer to service, measured against the agreed acceptance criteria, and supporting the go-live command centre. Hypercare and stabilisation: agreeing hypercare entry and exit criteria, monitoring stability and adoption signals, and handing over cleanly to ENGIE’s business-as-usual teams. Early releases and workarounds: planning for known limitations in early releases, and reflecting them in training, knowledge and communications so users are never caught by surprise. You’ll work with Release Management so each platform release arrives with the enablement it needs. What you’ll bring Ideally, you’ll have: Several years of hands-on change delivery on large platform or systems transformations, with a recognised change management discipline. You solve a wide range of problems creatively and work with little supervision. Experience in regulated, customer-facing operational environments, including live customer account migration, cutover and go-live, where you have shaped the approach rather than only followed one. Strong communication and stakeholder management, credible with client programme leads and transformation sponsors. Fluency in French and English, written and spoken. Comfort working with data: you explore adoption and programme data yourself, report on it clearly and challenge decisions when evidence is weak. Commercial awareness: you understand how Kaluza makes money and balance what the client needs against cost, working alongside SI partners and the client’s own change resources without duplicating effort. What will set you apart: a background in energy retail or utilities, vendor-side experience on a SaaS implementation, and/or knowledge of contact centre operations and technology. Our Values Five values guide how we work at Kaluza: Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale. Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes. Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say. Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego. Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives. Our Perks Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance) Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility Come as you are We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you. As a Cloud Engineer, you will operate and support the cloud platforms that power The Exploration Company’s engineering, operations, and data workloads in France. You will design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure on AWS and SecNumCloud-qualified cloud services so teams can work securely and reliably across both environments. The Role The data center market is structuring fast, operators and landowners are hunting for sites, and the question they ask is one of capacity: how many megawatts of IT load does this land carry, under what scheme, and on what conditions. Under the supervision of a lead architect, you take these projects from first capacity through to schematic design, and you present them to the client. Qualify the applicable land-use category and the environmental-classification regime for industrial facilities, and derive from them the permitted height, the setbacks and the siting conditions. Draw the data halls at their real grid, fully laid out, with their aisles, their air-handling units and their structural grid. Compose the industrial site plan: service yards, a perimeter heavy-vehicle road, loading docks, retention basins, planted buffers, access and parking. Arbitrate between schemes, one level, two levels or more, while respecting the slab-to-slab height and the zoning height cap. Name the questions to put to the operator: cooling system, density per rack, electrical redundancy, hall dimensions, height. Carry your number in front of the client, and defend it under challenge. Place the project on its critical path: grid connection, environmental permitting, ecological surveys, preventive archaeology. Contribute to the technology Formalize data center best practice, translating the sizing cascade, the grids and the thresholds into criteria our AI teams can use. Qualify the model's outputs, saying what is right, what is wrong, and on what grounds. Work across the product, tech and real estate teams, inside the tool's continuous-improvement cycles. Work as a team Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve the methods and the quality of the deliverables. Contribute to the team's graphic standards. Applied regulatory fluency, the land-use sub-category and the 2023 ruling that reclassified data centers, the environmental-classification headings and the threshold that triggers a full environmental permit, height and setback rules, no-net-land-take targets and designation as a project of major national interest, rooftop renewable-energy requirements. Buildable capacity, linking a rule to its quantified effect on a volume, and a volume to an installable power. Industrial site planning, heavy-vehicle access, turning circles, fire safety, water management, insertion and edges. Graphic production, plans, sections and diagrams that make a capacity argument legible to an investor. Ownership of the subject, presenting, arguing and defending a number in front of a client who contests it. We are looking for someone who has owned the subject end to end, assumptions, number and client presentation. Complementary skills Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases. Structuring information, organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it. An ability to work across the product, tech and real estate teams. A command of technical English, the vocabulary of the sector being largely English-speaking. Why Join Davis? Take part in a genuine transformation of the real estate profession, and co-build the next generation of feasibility standards alongside a high-caliber technical team. You will set Davis's data center method, and it will serve every project that follows. See your work in every deliverable, and correct the tool when it gets things wrong. description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Data Operations team owns the entire data lifecycle behind STARK's AI stack: collection, acquisition, generation, curation, and management. We run our own data-collection campaigns across Europe, evaluate new sensors and platforms, and build the internal data platform that turns raw recordings into ready-to-use datasets. Everything we produce feeds directly into the perception and autonomy systems deployed on STARK's platforms — a real data advantage is built, not bought. The team is scaling up right now: real scope, direct impact, no legacy.

YOUR MISSION

Data is the fuel of STARK’s AI stack - you build the engine that makes it usable. You own the software backbone of our data platform: the metadata systems, ETL pipelines, data contracts, catalogs, databases, and internal tools that let engineers find, understand, validate, and reuse terabytes of multi-sensor field data in minutes, not days. You treat data context as a product: structured, searchable, version-aware, documented, and traceable from raw recording to processed asset, annotation delivery, dataset, and downstream ML workflow. Success in this role requires seamless cross-functional collaboration—acting as the central hub between the teams collecting data in the field, our external annotation vendors, and the ML engineers training the models. Your job is to design the automated workflows and data tooling that unify these groups, transforming raw operational data into reliable, high-quality systems at scale.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Build the Data Backbone: Design, write, and maintain robust Python software and ETL pipelines that ingest, process, and merge complex field recordings (flight data, rosbags, video) and external deliveries into our GCP cloud storage.
  • Create Data Tooling: Build the programmatic tools that bridge raw data and downstream usage. This includes writing services to automatically sub-sample video feeds, extract valuable frames, package datasets, and build self-serve data access tools.
  • Database & Metadata Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain our metadata databases and data catalogs (tracking datasets, recordings, sensors, labels, and lineage) using solid SQL and schema design principles.
  • Data Operations & Labeling Workflows: Own the end-to-end technical workflows for data curation and labeling. You will build the operational tooling and coordinate with external labeling subcontractors to ensure high-quality data deliveries, track progress, and run automated QA.
  • Internal Tooling & APIs: Develop backend APIs, self-service dashboards, and data-access tools that allow the entire AI and engineering organization to quickly search, filter, and understand terabytes of multi-sensor data.
  • Drive Engineering Excellence: Establish and enforce good software engineering hygiene in a young codebase: rigorous testing, typing, documentation, logging, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Generalist Problem Solving: Thrive in an evolving startup environment. Take on ambiguous problems, migrate legacy data, handle access management, and aggressively automate away manual support tasks.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Strong Software Engineering in Python: You write clean, typed, tested, and maintainable Python code. You approach data problems with a software developer's mindset.
  • Data Engineering & ETL: Proven experience designing, building, and operating robust ETL/data ingestion pipelines.
  • Database Mastery: Solid SQL (PostgreSQL preferred) with a strong grasp of schema design, data modeling, and metadata systems.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with object storage (GCP/GCS, S3) and the basics of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD.
  • Unix/Linux Environments: Strong familiarity with Unix-based systems, shell scripting, and standard Unix tools. You are comfortable working natively in a Linux environment.
  • Pragmatic & Adaptable: You know how to balance a quick, scrappy fix with a long-term architectural solution, and you are highly comfortable with the changing priorities of a startup environment.
  • Communicator & Coordinator: You are comfortable working cross-functionally and coordinating with external vendors and non-technical stakeholders to drive data labeling and curation efforts.
  • Automation Mindset: You aren't allergic to jumping in to do support tasks, but you have the technical chops to automate them away so you never have to do them twice.

NICE TO HAVE

  • GenAI / Synthetic Data: Experience with synthetic data generation or GenAI-assisted workflows (auto-labeling, data augmentation, foundation-model-based curation).
  • Data Ecosystems: Familiarity with data versioning (DVC, LakeFS, FiftyOne), computer vision annotation formats (e.g., COCO), or large-scale data curation workflows.
  • Advanced GCP: Experience with GCP services beyond basic storage (BigQuery, Cloud Run, IAM).
  • Robotics / Complex Data: Exposure to robotics data formats (ROS bags, MCAP, PX4 logs) or handling heavy, multi-modal data streams (video, lidar).

 

 

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

 

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

YOUR MISSION

You will take our directional mesh datalink from the lab bench onto real platforms and make it a fieldable, manageable, and verifiable network. You own everything between the radio and the rest of the system: the embedded software stack, network management, data transport, and the logging that proves the link works. No RF background is required. We are looking for a strong embedded and networking engineer who has put software on physical systems.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

STARK's Electronic Warfare team is a systems-focussed engineering group delivering software-defined, mass-scalable RF solutions for autonomous systems. Combining deep domain expertise in hardware board design, thermal/ structural packaging, real-time C++ signal processing, and resilient directional mesh networking, we rapidly build field advanced EW capabilities designed to survive and operate in contested spectrum environments. 

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Integrate the datalink onto platform compute: embedded Linux bring-up, drivers, deployment images, OTA updates, and secure boot.
  • Build network management: node identity, configuration and key distribution, health monitoring, and remote diagnostics of fielded nodes.
  • Own automated logging as a deliverable in its own right: time-aligned at both ends of the link and detailed enough to serve as evidence for programme milestones.
  • Implement telemetry and video transport (UDP/TCP, RTP) and the interfaces to ground control stations and our C2 software.

 

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Embedded Linux experience beyond the application level: bring-up, drivers, and product deployment.
  • Networking at packet level, including how UDP and TCP behave under loss.
  • You have integrated software onto a physical system (vehicle, robot, or aircraft) and you treat the log as a design object, not an afterthought.
  • C/C++, Python, and Yocto or a comparable build system.

 

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with the PX4, ArduPilot, or MAVLink ecosystem, ideally from a UAS manufacturer.
  • Video transport over constrained or lossy links.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

 

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We’re building a new B2B business for Firefox— bringing a privacy-first, data-safe browser and productivity bundle to European organizations. As we grow our EU-based demand generation team ahead of our Q1 2027 bundle launch, we’re looking for an experienced Field Marketing Manager for France based in France. You will independently own the regional field plan, budget and senior Sales partnership for the France region and broader EU enterprise market. You will turn named-account priorities into a focused portfolio of high-value executive and technical experiences, with particular attention to French-language delivery, local enterprise buying dynamics, and the needs of complex, multi-stakeholder organizations. You’ll work closely with Sales, Channel, Product Marketing, and Content teams to bring our go-to-market strategy to life on the ground, and you’ll help build the processes and playbooks this team relies on as it scales from a small pilot into a full regional function. This is a hands-on senior role for a marketer who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: selecting the few moments that matter, orchestrating cross-functional and agency support, and ensuring each program creates a clear next step for a priority account

What you'll do:
  • Co-create the quarterly France and EU market field plan with Sales, translating selected accounts, account stage and stakeholder priorities into a sequenced engagement plan.
  • Design and run a small portfolio of high-touch programs, including executive roundtables, private briefings, technical workshops, pilot-readiness sessions and a deliberately selected set of industry events.
  • Define the intended account outcome for every program: the target stakeholders, the desired meeting or next step, the pre-event engagement plan, the seller handoff and the follow-up assets required.
  • Own the France and EU market field budget, agency and vendor relationships, timelines, risk and execution quality; use shared Mozilla teams and the European agency for production, localization, PR, web and media operations.
  • Create and localize program narratives and assets into French in partnership with Product Marketing and Content, ensuring relevance for enterprise IT, security, privacy, procurement and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Analyst Relations, Content/Creative, and Demand Gen colleagues to keep messaging consistent across the channel mix.
  • Develop locally relevant programs and assets with Product, Security and Solutions partners, who retain ownership of technical accuracy and validation.
  • Bring the voice of the French and EU market back to the team, including buyer concerns, competitor signals, account feedback and regional ecosystem insight; convert learning into better messaging, field playbooks and return-on-event decisions.
  • Build repeatable field operating rhythms and reporting, contribute to the 2027 launch and customer-proof plan, and create learning that supports 2028 European expansion.
  • Track and report on program performance, using pipeline and engagement data to refine regional tactics.
How Success will be measured:
  • Priority accounts progress to an agreed commercial, executive or technical next step.
  • The right stakeholders attend and engage; success is based on account quality and coverage, not attendee volume.
  • Sales accepts the handoff, completes follow-up and can see how each program contributed to account movement.
  • Executive meetings, technical workshops, pilot activity and procurement support increase in the selected account set.
  • Reusable French-language proof, playbooks and market insight are created on time and used by the team.
  • Programs meet quality, budget and operational commitments.
 What you’ll bring:
  • 5+ years of experience in field marketing, account-based marketing, enterprise events or regional go-to-market for B2B software, security or IT-managed products.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own a country or regional plan, budget, vendors and senior Sales relationships.
  • French native, fluent in English; German language skills preferred. Experience across the French market.
  • Strong understanding of complex enterprise buying groups, including IT, security, privacy, procurement and works council stakeholders.
  • Experience designing high-touch programs for named accounts and translating event activity into specific seller next steps.
  • Excellent project, agency and vendor management skills, with strong judgment about where to invest and what not to do.
  • A data-informed approach that combines program signals with account-level feedback and commercial context.
  • Comfort operating in an early-stage environment with ambiguity, high ownership and regular regional travel.
  • Excellent collaboration skills across marketing, sales, and cross-functional partners.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

description: TLDR; Davis is looking for an architect who has sized capacity across several programs, from light-industrial and logistics to residential, office and retail, and who wants to practice differently than in a traditional firm. Target experience: around 5 to 6 years. About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneurs First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. The Role Our clients come to us with a site and a capacity question, on a program that changes from one deal to the next. You are the one who answers whatever the program, and who stands behind the number in front of them. You will run a portfolio of feasibility studies across light-industrial and logistics, residential, office, hospitality, retail and mixed-use operations. You take these projects from feasibility through schematic design. This role sits at the meeting point of two worlds Davis is precisely working to bring together: architectural expertise and artificial intelligence. This is not a conventional architect position. It spans three complementary dimensions: guaranteeing the architectural quality and credibility of our deliverables, today generated in a matter of hours; co-producing the architectural drawings that accompany them; contributing actively to the development of our plan-generation technology. It is an architect role whose impact reaches well beyond its own output. The core of the role Analyze local planning and zoning documents (land-use plans, development guidelines, easements) and derive project assumptions from them. Set the programmatic assumptions for the program at hand, its ratios, structural grids and keys, and derive a quantified capacity. Check and correct the outputs of our tools: confirm what holds up, fix what does not, and explain why. Develop the project phase by phase, from a first capacity scenario through to a resolved project at schematic design. Produce the graphic documents (drawings, images, diagrams) that make the project clear and compelling. Arbitrate between several scenarios according to programmatic, regulatory and economic constraints. Stand behind your numbers with the client, and defend them under challenge. Contributing to the technology Formalize best practice, program by program: translate ratios, structural grids and thresholds into criteria our AI teams can use. Assess the model's outputs: say what is right, what is wrong, and on what grounds. Work cross-functionally with the product, tech and real estate teams throughout the tool's continuous-improvement cycles. Working as a team Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve methods and the quality of deliverables. Contribute to the team's graphic standards. What We're Looking For Education: degree in architecture. Experience: around 5 to 6 years. You have sized capacity yourself on at least three different programs (multi-family residential, logistics, light-industrial parks, office, hospitality or retail). Logistics or light-industrial is one of the three, as these are the programs that matter most to us. You know the ratios that govern each: clear height and loading docks in logistics and light-industrial, average area per unit and parking ratio in residential, structural grid and workstation ratio in office, area per key in hospitality. Software: proficiency in Rhino and Revit is essential. AutoCAD is expected. Appetite for digital tools and AI: the desire to bring them into your practice and to evolve it is essential. AI is one more tool in your hand, and drawing remains what we assess. Speed and synthesis: our clients decide fast, on a number. You produce a credible, well-drawn scenario in hours, you cut to the essentials on ambiguous cases, and you know what level of detail serves the decision at each phase. Core skills Buildable capacity: connect a zoning rule to its quantified effect on a volume, and a volume to a program. Programmatic versatility: move from residential to office, to logistics warehouse, to light-industrial or hospitality, and grasp the logic of each quickly. Planning documents and how they apply: building envelope, height, setbacks, spacing rules, footprint, planted open ground, parking, permitted uses. Site plan: siting, access, parking, water management, integration and edges. Project phases, from feasibility through schematic design, and the level of detail each one requires. Production of graphic documents: plans, sections and diagrams that make a capacity rationale legible to an investor. Complementary skills Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases. Information structuring: organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it. Ability to work cross-functionally with the product, tech and real estate teams. Why join Davis? Take part in a genuine transformation of the real estate profession, and co-build the next generation of feasibility standards alongside a high-caliber technical team. Go through a volume and a diversity of programs a traditional firm cannot offer. See your work in every deliverable, and correct the tool when it gets things wrong. Join a young company where methods and tools are still being built, and where your expertise shapes the way we work. Package Fixed-term or permanent contract depending on the case, to be discussed together Offices in the center of Paris 2e Company health insurance covered Meal vouchers Sports membership covered 50% reimbursement of public transport More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after: Team Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need. Why We'll Win Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description:
4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.

The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.

What You'll do

The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.

The program places you inside one of two business units:

Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.

Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.


For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.

​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.

You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.

What You’ll Bring

You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:

  • Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.
  • Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.
  • Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian.
  • Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.
  • Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.
  • You are at the start of your career and have maximum three years of junior work experience.

What’s In It for You

​​Show us what you can do, and in return, we promise you the experience of a lifetime. We offer you a transformative journey filled with learning, growth, and invaluable experiences that will shape your perspective and personal and professional development. On top of that, you’ll also take part in some fascinating courses and events:

  • Introductory Global Summit: Experience 4 days at our global headquarters in Liechtenstein, featuring the presence of our Executive Board and Global Senior Leadership. The summit offers a comprehensive overview of our business, while fostering soft skill development and meaningful collaboration with fellow program participants.
  • Social Project Summit: 7 days dedicated to building a better future, with contribution to a hands-on, high-impact community project. This experience offers the chance to immerse yourself in a different culture while actively improving living conditions for those in need.
  • Leadership Summit: An enriching learning journey in partnership with a renowned business school, featuring online modules and collaborative projects with fellow program participants. The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.

Why Hilti

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

Learn more about our recruitment process: https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/

Commitment to Inclusion

​​At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

​Exciting software journey: You will dive into the fast-paced world of our construction software business, gaining exposure to innovative digital solutions that are transforming one of the world's largest industries.
​
​Global cross-team collaboration: You will work with colleagues worldwide and get guidance from a dedicated mentor as you grow in your career.

​We hire for a career, not for a position. If you are looking for long-term career prospects and opportunities to grow, this is the perfect start.​

​Are you ready to jumpstart your career? Our hiring process is designed to help you showcase your skills and experience. The process has multiple steps and requires a longer period of time:

  • It all starts with your application and a video interview.
  • Get connected with our HR team in an online interview.
  • Get ready to flex your problem-solving muscles with our online Business Case Round.
  • Impress our Business Line Managers with your presentation skills and insights during the next round.
  • And, if you make it to the end, you'll receive an invitation to our Assessment Center.

​Exciting, right? Let's get started!

4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

​The Assessment Center will take place in Liechtenstein at Hilti Headquarter on December 1st and 2nd, 2026. Applications will be reviewed in the order they’re received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible since there are limited spots for the Assessment Center!​

Learn more about our recruitment process:

Candidate Interview Preparation

​​For further questions, please feel free to contact Vanessa Furtner ----- and (My LinkedIn).
​
*For non-EU / EFTA citizens: Please state your eligibility status to work in EU or UK countries and note that if you do not own a valid work permit, Hilti cannot guarantee your final employment due to authority regulations.​

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Overview

WPP Media is seeking a Head of Strategy & Insights to lead the global media strategies for one of the most prestigious global luxury groups in the world. Sitting at the intersection of culture, audience, planning, and insights, you will oversee a talented team to deliver transformative media strategies across a prestigious portfolio of Maisons.

For this critical leadership role, we are seeking an "M-shaped" talent. You bring a broad knowledge of communications, media, and luxury, combining big-picture strategic thinking with the technical fluency to dive into expert topics. You are equally comfortable advising on high-level strategy as you are coordinating specialized teams to turn macro-visions into high-quality execution.

As a trusted advisor to Maisons C-suite stakeholders, you will go beyond traditional media planning to shape long-term brand equity, champion luxury intelligence, and elevate planning excellence across our global network of over 40 markets.

* Location: Paris

* Team management: 5-6 people (Senior to Manager Media Planning & Insights Talents)

* Client: Global Luxury group

* Language: French & English

Key Responsibilities

  1. Strategy & Planning Excellence
  • Team Leadership: Direct and inspire a global team of five strategic planners (ranging from Manager to Senior profiles), ensuring the high-quality delivery of strategic media recommendations across diverse briefs and a varied Maisons portfolio.
  • Annual Media Strategy: Define the overarching annual media strategy for the group leading Maisons, across various luxury categories.
  • Media Guidelines: Define and oversee the creation of media planning guidelines (annual or high-stakes campaigns). Establish their structure and coordinate relevant internal teams (e.g., Social and Search experts) to ensure their successful completion.
  • Planning Framework: Elevate local market planning quality by refining existing planning frameworks and enforcing their adoption, supported directly by the Planning & Insights Capabilities Associate Director.

 

  1. Luxury Thought Leadership & Intelligence
  • Intelligence Agenda: Define the annual Luxury Thought Leadership calendar; oversee the creation and presentation of high-impact intelligence reports and global webinars.
  • Macro-Consultancy: Partner with Maisons and relevant WPP agencies on forward-looking, long-term prospective topics that extend well beyond pure paid media.
  • Knowledge Ecosystem: Foster a culture of luxury intelligence-sharing, ensuring a seamless flow of insights between central and local market teams.

 

  1. Tools & Insights
  • Planning & Insights Capability: Manage and mentor the Insights & Planning Capabilities Associate Director to enforce the consistent application of WPP Media "hero" planning and insight tools across the entire account network, ensuring data-driven strategic foundations.
  • Global Research Agenda: In collaboration with the Insights & Planning Capabilities Associate Director, define the global studies agenda, overseeing research execution and the delivery of actionable insights to the client.

  1. Local Market Support & Connectivity
  • Global Upskilling: Refine and deploy planning and insights training programs tailored for local market teams and planning resources.
  • Network Synergy: Build influential relationships with top-tier global markets to capture local best practices, maximize global strategy adoption, and elevate localized execution.

 

Requirements & Profile

  • Global Strategic Planning Experience: 10–15+ years of experience within integrated communications and media planning, with a heavy emphasis on global or multi-market accounts.
  • Luxury Expertise: Deep, demonstrable expertise within the luxury sector (Fashion, Jewelry, and Watches preferred), with a thorough understanding of the luxury consumer mindset and differences across Maisons and regions.
  • Holistic Comms Thinking: Proven ability to think beyond traditional paid media, demonstrating an integrated communications planning mindset that connects media strategy with broader cultural and brand ecosystems.
  • C-Suite Gravitas: Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with a proven ability to engage, persuade, and challenge C-suite executives through strong, well-reasoned convictions.
  • Team Management: A proven track record of managing, mentoring, and inspiring diverse strategic teams; a natural collaborator and team player.
  • Strategic Agility: A highly flexible thinker capable of adapting strategic frameworks across a wide variety of brands with vastly different budgets, target audiences, and ambitions.
  • Cross-Department Orchestration: Proven ability to collaborate with and coordinate across diverse, specialized expert teams (e.g., Social, Search, and Centralized Buying) to align channel tactics with overarching macro-strategy.
  • Language: Full professional fluency in both English and French
  • Curiosity: A genuine appetite for working in a highly international, multicultural environment.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment.

Isar Aerospace is building Spectrum, a European launch vehicle. As an Intern in Data Engineering, you help bring engineering, manufacturing, business and operations data into one place, connecting sources to our emerging warehouse, building reliable data models and delivering dashboards that support company decisions.

Bonus Skills

Benefits

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns, empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp.   • Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem

  • Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought

Tout expert a un jour été débutant ! Tu auras de nombreuses occasions de te mettre au défi et de t'épanouir, notamment grâce aux sessions Lunch & Learn et à la formation sur mesure en compétences non techniques. Nous proposons également des cours de langue professionnels hebdomadaires gratuits.
