Role Overview As Harvey scales its pre-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager to lead and grow the team in Munich. This role exists to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Legal Engineers who sit at the heart of Harvey's commercial motion - bringing legal credibility, product expertise, and consultative support to law firm and in-house prospects. Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective. Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area. Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations. What You'll Do Lead, coach, and develop a team of Legal Engineers, setting clear performance expectations and building a high-trust, high-output team culture Own the quality and consistency of Harvey's pre-sales legal engineering function, ensuring demos, discovery conversations, and deal support are delivered to the highest standard Partner closely with Account Executives and GTM leadership to prioritise pipeline, develop deal strategy, and support conversion on complex or strategic opportunities Engage with lawyers at prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges Collaborate with Product and Marketing to ensure the team's field insights are feeding into positioning, roadmap, and go-to-market strategy Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases. Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens. Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices. What You Have Qualified lawyer with 7+ PQE, with experience in a law firm or in-house legal environment Must have prior experience managing a team, with a track record of developing talent and driving performance Deep familiarity with legal technology and AI tools, with an ability to quickly develop and demonstrate platform expertise Strong commercial instincts and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders at law firms and in-house legal teams Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience running training, workshops, or client-facing product sessions Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. description: Montagmorgen, 08:15 Uhr: Bei einem Kunden kann niemand mehr auf SharePoint zugreifen, zwei neue Mitarbeitende warten auf ihr Intune-Gerät und eine Postfachregel leitet seit Freitag Mails ins Leere. Alles ist irgendwie dringend und nicht alles ist gleich wichtig. Du bringst Ordnung hinein: Du erkennst, was brennt, löst selbst, was du lösen kannst, und gibst den Rest gezielt an die richtigen Specialist Engineers weiter. Unsere Kunden merken davon vor allem eines, nämlich dass es funktioniert. Wir bei Epic Fusion sind ein AI-native Team: unkompliziert, kurze Wege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir probieren Neues aus, ganz im Sinne von «Learn it over Know it», und bauen es direkt in unsere Prozesse ein. Unseren Helpdesk verstehen wir als intelligente, agentengestützte Serviceplattform und nicht als Ticketsystem. Nicht alles funktioniert auf Anhieb, aber wir lernen schnell und bauen auf dem auf, was sich bewährt. Ein fertiges Prozesshandbuch für jede Situation gibt es bei uns nicht. Wenn du das brauchst, sind wir nicht die Richtigen. Wenn du es lieber selbst schreibst, schon. Das gestaltest du bei uns: Den Überblick behalten: Du übernimmst die Ticket-Triage im B2B-Helpdesk, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass jeder Case beim richtigen Menschen landet. Selbst lösen: Second-Level-Anfragen rund um Microsoft 365 bearbeitest du eigenständig, vom Troubleshooting über die Konfiguration bis zur Wurzelursachenanalyse. Du willst wissen, warum etwas kaputt war, und nicht nur, dass es wieder läuft. SLAs im Griff haben: Du überwachst SLAs und offene Cases und greifst ein, bevor etwas eskaliert. Kunden auf Augenhöhe begleiten: Du pflegst die Kundenbeziehung proaktiv. Unsere Kunden wissen, wen sie anrufen können, und vertrauen dir. Im Team spielen: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Operations- und Workplace-Specialists zusammen und gibst Fälle so weiter, dass niemand nachfragen muss. Den Helpdesk smarter machen: Was zweimal von Hand passiert, schaust du dir genauer an. Du gestaltest mit, wie AI-Agents und automatisierte Workflows Triage, Analyse und Kommunikation im Helpdesk übernehmen. description:
Job Description

As the National Account Executive - Retail, you will serve as a key operational and commercial partner to our National Account Managers across our key retail channels (Majors, Independents, and Petrol & Convenience). You will act as a primary liaison with retail buying teams to coordinate promotional execution, evaluate campaign performance, and partner cross-functionally across Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain to drive the growth of our Youfoodz retail business.

This role is based in Chippendale, Sydney and reports to the Senior National Account Manager.

 

You will…

  • Accurately track and manage customer promotional mechanics, trade spend investment, and records of promotional activity and pricing changes.
  • Partner with Commercial Finance to proactively investigate, track, and resolve customer claims, deductions, and discrepancies.
  • Generate weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales and commercial performance reports, highlighting key trends and variances for the NAM team.
  • Synthesize retail market and competitor insights across in-store, digital, and e-commerce channels.
  • Support demand planning and supply chain teams by providing volume forecasts based on confirmed promotional plans, monitoring stock-on-hand status, and mitigating out-of-stock risks.
  • Prepare impactful presentation materials for annual range reviews, category reviews, and new product development (NPD) sell-ins.
  • Coordinate the timely delivery of product samples, marketing assets, and retailer compliance documentation.
  • Serve as the operational bridge between the sales team and internal departments to troubleshoot day-to-day retailer queries regarding logistics, invoicing, and POS.

 

You have…

  • 1–3 years of experience in an analytical, administrative, field sales, or commercial support role within the FMCG or retail sector.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, data visualization) and experience managing complex commercial datasets.
  • Experience working with ERP or Trade Promotion Management (TPM) systems, retailer portals, or syndicated market data (e.g., Nielsen, IRI).
  • A strong understanding of the Australian retail landscape, commercial mechanics, and industry terminology (e.g., JBPs, trade spend, range reviews).

 

You are…

  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on data accuracy and financial integrity.
  • An exceptional organizer capable of balancing multiple cross-functional processes and retailer deadlines simultaneously.
  • A proactive problem-solver driven to investigate root causes and optimize operational workflows.
  • A clear, collaborative communicator confident in managing both internal cross-functional stakeholders and external retail buyer contacts.



What you’ll get in return… 

  • The chance to have a significant impact in a leading global food technology company
  • Flexible working arrangements 
  • Egoless environment, constant learning with room for personal growth
  • Free access to Headspace
  • Internal learning & development 
  • A diverse and vibrant international environment, with offices in 18 countries
  • Company discount - 70% off HelloFresh & 40% off Youfoodz

Start Date: Immediately available - Can wait a notice period

Duration: Permanent full time role

Location: Chippendale Head Office - hybrid working environment 

Salary: Competitive salary & employee benefits

description: TLDR; Davis is looking for a residential specialist, excellent in plan and in drawing, who wants to practice the craft differently than in an agency. We expect around three to four years of experience. About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneurs First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. The role This role sits at the meeting point of two worlds Davis is working to bring together: architectural expertise and artificial intelligence. It is not a conventional architect role. It spans three complementary dimensions: guaranteeing the quality and architectural credibility of our deliverables, now generated in hours; co-producing the architectural plans that go with them; and actively contributing to the development of our plan-generation technology. It is an architect role whose impact reaches well beyond your own output. You will run a portfolio of residential projects, under the supervision of a lead architect, from feasibility through to schematic design. The core of the role Read the local planning documents (zoning plans, development-orientation schemes, easements) and derive the project assumptions from them. Develop massing, circulation principles and capacity scenarios consistent with the regulatory framework. Certify the architectural credibility of what the pipeline produces, confirming that each plan is sound and setting out the reasoning behind it. Develop the project phase after phase, from a first capacity scenario through to a resolved project at schematic design. Produce the graphic documents (plans, images, diagrams) that make the project clear and compelling. Arbitrate between scenarios against programmatic, regulatory and economic constraints. Contribute to the technology Formalize best practice, translating what a strong residential plan respects into criteria our AI teams can use. Qualify the model's outputs, defining the standard a strong plan meets and validating each result against it, with the reasoning. Work across the product, tech and real estate teams, inside the tool's continuous-improvement cycles. Work as a team Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve the methods and the quality of the deliverables. Contribute to the team's graphic standards. Who We Are Looking For Education: a degree in architecture. Experience: around 3 to 4 years in an agency, ideally one specialized in residential work. You have a real command of the residential floor plan and can, from a site and a brief, produce credible, well-drawn capacity scenarios. Software: mastery of Rhino and Revit is essential, and AutoCAD is expected. Appetite for digital tools and AI: you do not need to code, but the drive to fold these tools into your practice and push it forward is essential. Speed and synthesis: our clients are real estate developers, whose demands are first about speed and efficiency. You need to produce a credible, well-drawn scenario in hours, cut to the essential on ambiguous cases, and know what level of detail serves the decision at each phase. Domain skills Command of the residential floor plan, circulation, orientation, building depths, cores, the unit-type mix from studio to four-bedroom, tenure types (market-rate, social, intermediate, and affordable home-ownership). Command of the planning documents and how they apply, massing envelope, height, setbacks, spacing rules, footprint, permeable ground, parking, land-use categories. From rule to impact, linking a rule to its concrete effect on a plan or a buildable capacity. Project phases, a solid grasp of the phases from feasibility to schematic design, and what each one implies in level of detail. Graphic production, images and diagrams that explain the project and make it legible. Complementary skills Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases. Structuring information, organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it. An ability to work across the product, tech and real estate teams. Why Join Davis? Work on a real transformation of the real estate profession and co-build a next-generation feasibility standard with a high-caliber technical team. Have a direct, visible impact on every deliverable and take part in the continuous progress of the technology. Be exposed to a rare volume and diversity of projects. Join a driven, ambitious team, in a young, growing company where the methods and the tools are still being built and where your expertise truly counts. Enough to learn fast and shape the way we work. Package Full-time fixed-term contract, with the possibility of moving to permanent Competitive compensation based on profile Offices in the center of Paris 2e Private health insurance covered Meal vouchers Gym membership covered 50% of commuting costs reimbursed More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after: Team Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need. Why We'll Win Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Suivre l’adoption et la stabilité opérationnelle pendant l’hypercare, analyser les causes racines de tout écart par rapport aux critères d’acceptation, et convenir avec ENGIE des actions correctives. Améliorer le playbook de préparation de Kaluza : faire évoluer ce qui a fonctionné sur ENGIE Belgique, tester des correctifs là où cela ne suffit pas en France, et partager vos enseignements avec vos collègues de Client Delivery pour façonner les fondations opérationnelles de la plateforme, ses améliorations et nos standards globaux. Au quotidien, vous piloterez ou soutiendrez notamment les activités suivantes : Impacts du changement et planification de la préparation : diagnostiquer l’ensemble des impacts sur les rôles, les processus, les systèmes et l’expérience client, puis les traduire en un plan de préparation priorisé, séquencé en fonction du rythme de livraison, de migration et de mise en production. Parties prenantes, sponsors et réseaux du changement : cartographier les parties prenantes et leur influence au niveau de chaque chantier, aider les sponsors à rester visibles et engagés, et structurer les réseaux de champions, de super-utilisateurs et de managers qui porteront le changement au sein du business d’ENGIE. Hypercare et stabilisation : définir les critères d’entrée et de sortie de l’hypercare, suivre les signaux de stabilité et d’adoption, et assurer une passation propre aux équipes d’exploitation d’ENGIE. Premières versions et solutions de contournement : anticiper les limitations connues des premières versions et les refléter dans les formations, les contenus de connaissance et les communications, pour que les utilisateurs ne soient jamais pris au dépourvu. Une expérience dans des environnements opérationnels régulés et en contact avec les clients, incluant la migration de comptes clients en production, la bascule et le go-live, où vous avez contribué à définir l’approche plutôt que de simplement en suivre une. Une sensibilité commerciale : vous comprenez comment Kaluza gagne de l’argent et savez arbitrer entre les besoins du client et les coûts, en travaillant aux côtés des partenaires intégrateurs et des ressources change du client, sans doublonner les efforts. 🚀 About the role

Career track: IC4

Unit: Shared Services

 

Genio has given everyone access to Claude, but most of what makes AI work across a company doesn’t exist here yet: connections to our business systems, a shared skills library, people in each team who can help their colleagues, and the checks that keep it safe. This role designs and builds that system, then gets every team using it.

 

It’s a hands-on building role. We buy and configure leading platforms rather than build our own agent infrastructure, and you’ll write code and build custom integrations wherever configuration isn’t enough. Success is measured by how well other teams build and run their own workflows.

 

You will be responsible for:

  • Design. You design how our AI platforms, connectors, skills and agents fit together. You track what’s changing in AI tools, recommend platform and model choices to the Head of BizOps, and judge new tools on measured performance, reliability, security and cost.
  • Build and run. You build and maintain the integrations and agents that connect our AI platforms to business systems such as our CRM and our documentation, communication and finance tools. You’re responsible for the health of the whole system: spotting failures and out-of-date skills, and tracking use and cost by team so they can be recharged and reported. Champions answer first-line questions and IT handles access, while you handle escalations and fix root causes so problems don’t come back.

description:
About Electra

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.

The Role

Electra.aero is seeking an experienced Senior Airspace Engineer to develop the methods, operational concepts, procedures, airspace solutions, and policies needed to safely integrate Ultra Short operations into the national airspace system, including at major airports and novel, distributed access points.

The engineer will shape flight demonstrations, tabletop exercises, simulations, and data collection to inform Ultra Short policy, guidance, and standards development in the US and Europe. Collaboration with the FAA, NATCA, and industry standards development organizations is central to the role.

This role requires a deep understanding of how aircraft performance, flight operations, airspace design, VFR/IFR procedures, PBN, RNAV/RNP operations, obstacle evaluation, navigation systems, FAA/EASA regulations, and real-world operational constraints intersect. The successful candidate will translate new aircraft capabilities and operational concepts into safe, certifiable, and operationally useful flight-path infrastructure.

The ideal candidate understands airspace design and air traffic management concepts, tools, and workflows across congested terminal and en route airspace, and has led or contributed to research translating novel aircraft capabilities into operational procedures. They are comfortable working directly with the FAA, international civil aviation authorities, air navigation service providers, airport authorities, and local stakeholders to advance integration projects. Firsthand experience in procedure design, airspace design, or air traffic control is valuable; working familiarity with the FAA’s 8260-series Orders is expected.

The engineer will collaborate with Electra and FAA teams through Electra’s Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA) with the FAA Tech Center, the FAA eIPP program, the Virginia Smart Airspace Program, and the International Test Arena in Norway, as well as through company-led testing and procedure development.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate EL9 performance characteristics into Ultra Short operational capabilities, including ground footprint, obstacle clearance, and maneuvering.
  • Collaborate with aircraft performance engineers to model EL9 capabilities under normal, degraded, and contingency conditions, incorporating system safety analysis to define feasible Ultra Short procedures.
  • Develop candidate procedures for novel urban access points and existing airports, taking into account EL2/EL9 Ultra Short performance, instrument procedure design criteria, airport traffic flows, and the obstacle environment.
  • Review FAA, EASA, ICAO, and national standards—including fixed-wing, heliport, and vertiport frameworks, FAA 8260-series Orders, and international equivalents—to identify regulatory and policy gaps affecting proposed procedures.
  • Evaluate candidate procedures with Electra’s product team, the FAA, airport operations teams, and local air traffic control to prepare for flight demonstrations, tabletop exercises, simulations, and future policy and standards development.
  • Define learning objectives and data collection requirements for flight demonstrations and simulations to validate operational concepts.
  • Synthesize flight test results, lessons learned, and operational insights to inform regulatory workstreams developing Ultra Short policy and standards.
  • Support Electra’s commercial and infrastructure partnerships teams in assessing the feasibility of candidate access points in urban settings and at airports.
  • Develop thought leadership materials that clearly explain novel Ultra Short operational concepts to regulators, local stakeholders, and airport authorities.
  • Represent Electra in FAA, EASA, and ICAO working groups and industry standards development organizations to help shape standards, guidance, and policy for Ultra Short airspace integration and operations.

What you Bring

  • Master’s degree or PhD in aerospace engineering, aviation management, airport planning, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in airspace management research, policy and regulatory development, airspace or procedure design, or a related domain.
  • Strong working knowledge of FAA and/or EASA regulatory frameworks, including the AC 150 series, Part 135, Part 23, TERPS/PANS-OPS, 8260-series Orders, and relevant airport design standards.
  • Experience working with regulators, air navigation service providers, airport operators, and industry partners.
  • Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment with evolving requirements and limited precedent.

Bonus Points

  • Experience leading or contributing to airspace integration research, including FAA, NASA, or MITRE airspace modernization initiatives.
  • Experience as an air traffic controller or with a non-FAA service provider specializing in instrument procedure design and development.
  • Private or commercial pilot experience.

 

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance; STD, LTD, and life insurance
  • Generous PTO, sick leave, and company holidays
  • Paid winter break
  • 401(k) with immediate vesting
  • Free catered lunches, coffee, snacks, and drinks at our Manassas headquarters
  • Free on-site parking

Electra is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This position may be subject to ITAR requirements.

De mens blijft verantwoordelijk voor keuzes en resultaten, terwijl AI ondersteunt bij onderdelen van het werk. Reporting to the Director of Leads & Prospects in New York, you will be a part of the strategy team, supporting global marketing leadership, shaping how HelloFresh Group engages, nurtures, and converts prospective customers across 17 markets and six brands.

You will be responsible for identification and collection of communication consents from leads arriving from acquisition channels. You will actively collaborate with our Product team, to ensure a smooth and customer friendly experience, as well as legal compliance. Once leads are “captured” you will collaborate with the lifecycle team on conceptualization, personalization and localization of global lifecycle journeys for leads and prospects across all communication channels. Working within a distributed, international team across multiple time zones, you will play a key role in aligning strategy and execution globally.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Run the Leads capture program: Defining and implementing the end-to-end lifecycle campaigns within CRM strategy for leads and prospects across different channels (from first touch to conversion). Alongside applying the data-driven segmentation, personalisation, and lifecycle frameworks, leveraging AI as well as dynamic content to drive engagement, conversion, and pipeline quality across international markets.
  • Running Omnichannel Campaigns: Orchestrate all communication channels within lifecycle campaigns (email, SMS, WhatsApp, push, in-app), defining best practices to drive engagement, and contribute to meeting overall team goals.
  • Continuous Improvement of Lifecycle Journeys: Partnering with Brand and Creative teams to bring and continuously improve high-quality, consistent, and locally adaptable CRM communications. Run content and design AB tests and optimizations in our customer journeys. 
  • Global Stakeholder Partnership: For allocated local markets, you will be serving as the CRM partner to global marketing teams, implementing aligned strategy, providing performance insights, and aligning on tactics to achieve the goals. Additionally, responsible for cross-functional collaboration across Analytics, CRM Operations, Product, Pricing, and Brand teams for assigned topics.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years experience in CRM, lifecycle, or digital marketing, and ideally in prospect/lead nurture programmes (lead capture, nurture flows, behavioural triggers, and conversion optimisation).
  • Proven mobile channel expertise, including hands-on experience with email, SMS, Push Notifications, WhatsApp, or in-app messaging campaigns.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g. Iterable, Adobe, Braze, Bloomreach), data tools (e.g. Google Analytics, Tableau, Databricks), and CDP tools for segmentation, personalization, machine learning, and reporting.

description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Senior Digital Transformation & Process Optimisation Consultant (internal title: Senior Value Engineer) is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

The Role:

You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level French proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in French.

The role is based in Paris.

The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers 
  • Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

 

The qualifications you need:

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP),  experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in Aviation/Logistics/Transportation and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities   

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

 

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

YOUR MISSION

You will turn our directional mesh network into a sensor. Using the same aperture that carries traffic, you will build direction finding, spectrum sensing, and GNSS-free position estimation, and prove their accuracy in the field against surveyed references. You own the error budget and the evidence, from IQ samples up to a validated position.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

STARK's Electronic Warfare team is a systems-focussed engineering group delivering software-defined, mass-scalable RF solutions for autonomous systems. Combining deep domain expertise in hardware board design, thermal/ structural packaging, real-time C++ signal processing, and resilient directional mesh networking, we rapidly build field advanced EW capabilities designed to survive and operate in contested spectrum environments. 

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Build position estimation from the mesh itself under GNSS denial: TDOA/TOA ranging, multilateration, geometry and GDOP, the clock-synchronisation error budget, and fusion with platform navigation.
  • Develop the DF and baseline spectrum-sensing chain on the directional aperture that carries traffic, running concurrently with communications.
  • Own antenna calibration together with the antenna team, and keep it valid in the field.
  • Own the error budget, design validation campaigns against surveyed references, and produce the evidence packs for programme milestones.

 

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • You have measured DF accuracy against real signals and done localisation with an explicit geometry and error budget. Practical experience is what counts here, not GNSS integration or theory alone.
  • You have run measurement campaigns validated against a surveyed reference.
  • You have calibrated an antenna array yourself.
  • You work comfortably from IQ data and channel-level observables upward.

 

NICE TO HAVE

  • A background in direction finding, radar, or SIGINT, whether from industry, a research institute, or space-based SIGINT.
  • Publications with a real measurement section.
  • Kalman filter or factor-graph estimation.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

What you’ll do

  • Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities.
  • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

 

You are...

  • An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.
  • Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.
  • A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.
  • Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.
  • Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

 

You have...

  • 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.
  • Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.
  • Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.
  • Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.
  • Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo's marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you. We're looking for a Senior National Account Manager to join our UKI team. In this role, you'll manage the daily relationship with a portfolio of our largest restaurant partners, using data-driven insights to grow their sales and help them achieve operational excellence. Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining the National Accounts team. Working with partners of this scale means you will often tackle challenges that Deliveroo is facing for the first time, directly shaping the future of how we collaborate with the world's largest food brands. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Strategic Relationship Management: Act as the primary consultant for a portfolio of major restaurant partners, managing weekly operational meetings and high-level performance reviews. Data-Driven Insight: Monitor and analyse partner-specific goals, creating compelling narratives from complex data to show partners where and how they can improve. Consultative Growth: Increase revenue and health metrics by advising partners on best practices for selection, pricing, and service levels. Operational Training: Deliver in-person training sessions for key partners covering operational best practices, Deliveroo insights, and on-site troubleshooting. Regional Collaboration: Partner with regional Commercial Managers to identify and prioritise growth opportunities across specific UK zones. Marketing Integration: Work with restaurant marketing counterparts to design and deliver campaigns that create long-term value for both the partner and Deliveroo. Cross-Functional Advocacy: Identify opportunities to deepen relationships by involving and working with Deliveroo's Marketing, Operations, and Product teams. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others: Partnership Expertise: Proven experience in account management or a strategic partnerships role, ideally within a high-growth technology or marketplace environment. Analytical Rigour: The ability to manage large datasets and translate them into clear, applicable insights that drive business decisions. Communication & Influence: Effective relationship-building skills with the ability to communicate and present confidently to senior stakeholders. Operational Agility: A proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced setting. Collaborative Mindset: A team player who can work across functions to deliver complex, multi-layered projects. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders. 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility. 🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves. 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! Wir suchen einen Maklerbetreuer / Partner Manager Cyber Insurance (m/w/d) der unser Maklernetzwerk in Deutschland weiter aufbaut und entwickelt und dabei Versicherungs-Know-how mit Cybersecurity verbindet. Deine Aufgaben Du betreust und entwickelst ein bestehendes Netzwerk von Versicherungsmakler:innen und baust neue strategische Maklerpartnerschaften auf. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Makler Partner in allen vertrieblichen und fachlichen Fragen rund um unsere Cyber-Versicherungslösung. Du unterstützt Makler:innen aktiv bei der Identifikation, Ansprache und Beratung potenzieller Kunden und begleitest sie durch den gesamten Vertriebsprozess. Du führst regelmäßige Partnertermine durch, erkennst Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale und entwickelst gemeinsame Vertriebsstrategien zur Steigerung des Geschäftsvolumens. Du organisierst und moderierst Schulungen, Workshops und Webinare, damit unsere Partner unsere Lösungen sicher und erfolgreich vermitteln können. Du analysierst Vertriebskennzahlen, identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale innerhalb deines Partnerportfolios und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Du arbeitest eng mit Underwriting, Sales, Marketing und Customer Success zusammen, um die bestmögliche Erfahrung für Makler und Kunden sicherzustellen. Du vertrittst Eye Security auf Maklerveranstaltungen, Branchenevents und Messen und baust dein Netzwerk kontinuierlich aus. Du beobachtest Markttrends und Entwicklungen im Versicherungs- und Cybersecurity-Umfeld und bringst deine Erkenntnisse aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Partnerstrategie ein. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Betreuung und Entwicklung von Versicherungsmakler:innen, Versicherungsvertrieben oder relevanten Vertriebspartnern, als Maklerbetreuer bei einem Versicherer oder auch als Accountmanager bei einem Makler Ein bestehendes Netzwerk im deutschen Versicherungsmarkt ist von Vorteil. Erfahrung im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Versicherungsprodukte, idealerweise aus den Bereichen Insurtech, Fintech, Legaltech oder Compliance. Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Entwicklung von Partnern, Maklerbeziehungen oder Vertriebsportfolios. Hohe Eigeninitiative, unternehmerisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität. Erfahrung mit vertrieblichen KPIs und einem datengetriebenen Ansatz zur Geschäftsentwicklung. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (C2) und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Interesse an Cybersecurity und die Motivation, sich in einem dynamischen Zukunftsmarkt weiterzuentwickeln. Reisebereitschaft sollte bei 60% liegen. Das bieten wir dir Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Cybersecurity-Scale-ups Europas. Die Möglichkeit, eine innovative Cybersecurity-Produktlinie mitzugestalten, die effektive Cybersicherheit und Cyber-Versicherung auf globaler Ebene vereint. Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket inklusive Bonus. Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. Car Allowance Wahlfreiheit bei deiner Ausstattung: MacBook oder Dell Laptop sowie iPhone oder Android-Smartphone. Deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung hat bei Eye Security höchste Priorität – wir unterstützen dich aktiv auf deinem Karriereweg. description: Location: London, UK Hybrid. Level: C2 Team: People Team Salary: £35,000-£44,000 Reporting To: Senior People Operations Partner This role is based in London, and requires an existing right to work in the UK. At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship. Kaluza Overview Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life. With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen. What will I be doing? Own the People service desk queue day-to-day: triaging, responding to, and resolving employee queries, and keeping response times and queue health on track. Continuously improve our Jira Service Desk itself - refining triage, workflows, and automations - and feed recurring ticket themes back into our People Bot's knowledge base, so the answers people get before they ever need a human just keep getting better. Be the main point of contact for new joiners between offer and day one, partnering with Talent Acquisition to make pre-boarding seamless and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks. Own and continuously improve the onboarding experience end-to-end - from offer acceptance to day one and beyond - so every new hire feels genuinely welcomed and set up for success. Support payroll inputs, benefits administration, and compliance activities, making sure our processes hold up against internal policy and employment law requirements. As you grow into the role: help audit and redesign People processes, identifying where automation, AI, or self-service can reduce manual effort and put information directly in employees' hands. Roll up your sleeves on cross-functional People projects as they come up - whether that's a Reward cycle, a hiring initiative, or an experience improvement. About You Ideally, you'll have/be: Some experience in a People Operations or HR administrative role, with a genuine interest in how operational rigour underpins the employee lifecycle. Hands-on comfort with a HRIS, ideally Workday - confident entering and updating records accurately as part of onboarding and lifecycle admin, even if deeper reporting and analysis isn't your focus. A naturally curious, detail-oriented approach to data - happy to flag something that looks off, even while you're still building the experience to know exactly why. Some exposure to payroll input processes, or strong eagerness to learn them, with the attention to detail accurate processing demands. Some experience administering employee benefits (enrolment, changes, queries), and comfortable being a point of contact when something needs sorting. A habit of noticing when a process is clunky and saying so - you don't need to have led a full redesign yet, but you think about why something works the way it does. Experience using a service desk tool (Jira or similar) to manage and triage a queue, with a good instinct for keeping things moving and knowing what needs escalating. Awareness of compliance and employment law basics, and the judgment to flag rather than guess when something feels off. Clear, warm communication - equally comfortable writing to a nervous new joiner as flagging something to a manager. What will set you apart: You're curious about what AI and automation can do for People Operations, and you're already poking at tools and forming opinions rather than waiting to be told to explore what's next. You hold yourself to a high bar, and you'll say so if you think something could be better - even if you're not yet the one leading the fix. You share what you know and keep people in the loop - a new joiner never feels like they're chasing you for answers. Where you'll work We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week. Kaluza Values Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business: Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together. Our Perks Pension Scheme Discretionary Bonus Scheme Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP Life Assurance Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts 5% Flex Fund - to spend on the benefits you want most 26 days holiday Flexible Bank Holidays - Giving you an additional 8 days which you can choose to take whenever you like Progressive Leave Policy - With no qualifying service periods, including 26 weeks full pay if you have a new addition to your family Personal Learning Budget - Upskill, learn and grow! Home Office Budget And more! We want the best people We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential. We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you. description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Senior Presales and Solution Consultant (Internal Title: Senior Value Engineer) is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

The Role:

You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level French proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in French.

The role is based in Paris.

The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers 
  • Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

 

The qualifications you need:

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP),  experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities   

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

 

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Market & Competitive Intelligence: Track the competitive landscape and translate it into positioning, differentiation, and gaps to close. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. description: Die Rolle Wir haben in den letzten Jahren gezeigt, dass wir echte Kundenprobleme lösen können. Jetzt geht es darum, aus bewährten Lösungen wiederholbare Produkte zu machen, die sich skalierbar verkaufen und liefern lassen. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich! Du machst aus validierten Kundenlösungen skalierbare Produkte. Unser Product-Modell folgt drei Phasen: 0→1 (Kundenproblem verstehen, Lösung im Kundenfall beweisen), 1→n (daraus ein wiederholbares Produkt machen) und n (skalierbar verkaufen, liefern, weiterentwickeln). Dein Fokus liegt auf 1→ n1→n: Du klärst, was das Produkt ist, für wen, welchen messbaren Mehrwert es liefert und wie es als Standardangebot verkauft und geliefert wird. Du verantwortest Produkt und Produktisierung – Engineering, Delivery, Sales und Product Marketing bleiben für Umsetzung, Kundenprojekt, Opportunity und Vermarktung zuständig.
